entries.en: Moss campion flowered between the rocks beside the mountain path.
entries.zh: 无茎麦瓶草在山路旁的岩石间开着花。

entries.en: The gardener planted moss pink along the low stone wall.
entries.zh: 园丁沿着矮石墙种下了丛生福禄考。

entries.en: The agricultural station kept moth bean seeds in labelled packets.
entries.zh: 农业站将乌头叶菜豆种子保存在贴有标签的小袋中。
